title: Seventh Sister
description: A green-skinned Mirialan with a penchant for using small ID9 Seeker Droids to do her bidding, the Seventh Sister was a member of the Empire's elite Inquisitorius. She was tasked with hunting down the Jedi and other Force-sensitives during the dark times. She was also dispatched personally by Darth Vader, dark lord of the Sith, to track down Ahsoka Tano and her rebel friends. Wielding a spinning double-bladed Lightsaber, she was a deadly opponent to those who stood in her way.
